# uncertainty_v2 — generated by `a3bx3.uncertainty`; do not edit by hand

Held-out coverage of predictive intervals. Every interval is fitted on the outer training fold only (inner grouped CV); the outer test fold is never used to calibrate. Same outer folds as metrics_v2. Coverage = share of held-out predictions inside the interval; width in eV.

Guarantee: CV+ / jackknife+: marginal coverage >= 1 - 2 alpha under exchangeability (Barber et al., Ann. Stat. 2021). No guarantee on lobo/loao; conditional (per-compound) coverage is never guaranteed.

Exchangeability per split: **lobo** violated (whole B-family held out); **loao** violated (whole A-site held out); **gkf** holds: shuffled grouped KFold, test formulas a random subset; **loo** approximately holds: each formula left out once
